name: NTIRE 2023 Real-Time Image Super-Resolution (RTSR) Benchmark
description: This paper introduces a novel benchmark for efficient upscaling as part of the NTIRE 2023 Real-Time Image Super-Resolution (RTSR) Challenge, which aimed to upscale images from 720p and 1080p resolution to native 4K (x2 and x3 factors) in real-time on commercial GPUs. For this, we use a new test set containing diverse 4K images ranging from digital art to gaming and photography. We assessed the methods devised for 4K SR by measuring their runtime, parameters, and FLOPs, while ensuring a minimum PSNR fidelity over Bicubic interpolation. Out of the 170 participants, 25 teams contributed to this report, making it the most comprehensive benchmark to date and showcasing the latest advancements in real-time SR.
evaluation_method: PSNR and efficiency metrics (runtime/latency, parameters, FLOPs)
reputation: Well-regarded within the image super-resolution community as a comprehensive, competitive real-time 4K benchmark with strong participation from many teams.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; multi-objective evaluation combining fidelity (PSNR) and efficiency (runtime/latency, params, FLOPs); results depend on hardware and implementation; focused on high-resolution (4K) images.
